speaker: Ange Postecoglou
quote_text:
What are your thoughts on your team's  performance today? Oh look, it was a  
difficult day for us obviously, and a painful  result. Credit to Liverpool. I thought, you know,  
they're a very good side, obviously. They're in a  great moment, very settled and in great form with  
great belief. And it was just a kind of bridge too  far for us today in terms of, yeah, you could tell  
we were lacking a little bit of energy and sort  of, yeah, the ability to really, you know, compete  
with them at the same level. You kind of said that  you want to play your football no matter what the  
season. And was this just an example of maybe, you  know, in the long term you'll benefit from this,  
but today it was a bit, you had kind of picked  apart a little bit because of the openings? Look,  
I think I've been really, really patient the last  18 months, sitting up here answering the same  
questions over and over again. If people want me  to change my approach, it's not going to change.  
Like we're doing it for a reason. We're doing it  because we think it'll help us be successful. If  
people don't understand the circumstances we're  in at the moment and the challenges we have from  
a team and squad perspective, which are as obvious  as you want to make them. Now, you know, I get the  
idea that people think, yeah, that I should just  flip the switch and change and somehow that would  
miraculously make us a different team. But it is  what it is. So I'll I'm just going to continue to  
stay focused on trying to build this team, to be  the team we want. And, you know, in the interim,  
we're going to have to, you know, accept that  they're going to be challenges along the way. Did  
Liverpool show you the sort of yardstick? Yeah,  fair bit. Fair bit considering they're... Yeah,  
no, fair bit. I'll just leave it at that. Go on.  Yep, they're a good side, top side. Top side. I  
know you mentioned about the level as I know  you've got a lot of injuries. I was wondering  
how far away is it from full strength? Don't  know because we haven't had that. You know,  
we're still growing as a team. We're 18 months  into trying to build a new team with a new way  
of playing and it's fair to say we've had  some challenges along the way considering,  
you know, the availability particularly and, you  know, particularly at the moment. So that kind  
of it's very hard to sort of see where we're  at. But what I will say is that, you know,  
the players and, you know, not wavering in their  sort of commitment to what we're trying to do.  
And I think, yeah, even today in a difficult  day, yeah, really proud of the fact that they,  
you know, still try to play a certain way  knowing that that's our way forward. Ange,  
perhaps not the story, but Deki’s scored five  games in a row now. Does it kind of feel like  
he's adding that really consistent end product  to his game? Perhaps not. Yeah. Look, I think,  
I think Deki's been outstanding all year and  yeah, like I said, I think that's probably the  
next part of his game. Not that he's never had  it, but he's he's adding that now where he's,  
you know, he's being really clean with his with  his finishing and it's a credit to him. He's taken  
his game to another level. I think a few of the  boys have to be fair. It's probably not as evident  
at the moment because of, like I said, we're we're  in a difficult situation. Two fans for singing  
your name. It's quite rare that should get  stuck losing that stall out. What does that  
say about the support they're giving you? Yeah,  look, look, the fans, you know, I've often said,  
I, I always say the fans, you know, they should  feel, you know, the way they they need to about  
what's happening. I thought they were good today,  very good today in terms of it was a difficult  
day for sure, but you know, they still got support  of the players, which is important. And who knows,  
maybe some of them actually understand the  situation we're in right now. That seems  
many don't. So I think in the context of what  we're trying to do and where we're at, you know,  
I kind of hope that they see what we're we're  trying to build here because I really believe it's  
it's going to be something that will give the fans  and the club what it wants. But, you know, that's  
up to them. With that in mind, Ange, are you going  to look into that break after Newcastle already?  
Games just about kind of going through the same  group. And then we've been doing that for the  
last three weeks. You know, we, we, you know, you  know, pretty much, you know, after the City game,  
we've, we've kind of been, you know, we had a  look at it. We knew that it was going to be this  
was going to be our toughest. For sure, because  you know, the the efforts of players are putting  
in. I think we've had shorter turnarounds than  just about every opponent we've played so far,  
at least one less day than just about every two. I  think every team have played, whether it's here or  
in Europe. And I haven't been able to change the  team or rest players or rotate players. And well,  
I said I, I, you know, I've got massive admiration  for the efforts that these players are putting in  
for this club at the moment. But we know we're  in a difficult situation and that's not going  
to change in the short term. And we just got  to, we just got to push on. We have talked  
to you a few weeks ago about being table 10th  by Christmas and that's where you are with all  
those reasons that you talk about. Do you feel  any pressure about where you are in the table?  
I'm not sure you mean by pressure. I mean, I'm  not happy where we are in the table, but I'm not  
sure pressure is in what sense really that this  is ultimately or I'm just tend to get judged on.  
Well, I think I am getting judged on that. I don't  think people are throwing the platitudes at me. So  
I think that's fair enough. Again, yeah, from my  perspective, all I can do is try and like I said,  
navigate us through a difficult. And, you know,  try and make sure that we do get to a position  
where hopefully we have, you know, a healthier  squad and and some key players back that we're  
still in a position where we can improve our  position on the table. But if you're saying  
that 10th means that I'm not doing a good job  and that I maybe, you know, somehow should be  
uncomfortable, well, that's that's for others  to judge and to give them the situation that  
they're in reliance energy referring to the  schedule and like, you know, the schedule is  
going to stay very difficult. Do you think that  reinforcements are needed in January? Yeah,  
absolutely. Some of them will be internal. Like  I said, we've got, you know, at different stages.  
We'll get players back from injury. Obviously  we've got a couple of long term and Vicario and  
and Wilson, but you know the rest. Hopefully  at some point in January they'll come back.  
So they'll, they'll, they'll help us in terms of  just getting some numbers back and dealing with,  
like you said, the schedule, because the  schedule's not going to change. You know,  
we're in the, we're in the Carabao Cup semi  final. We're still in Europe. The FA Cup  
starts. So we're still in all the competitions.  So it's not going to get any easier. So we, we,  
we are going to need some of those players  hopefully to come back and, and be able to  
contribute. Can you bring players in, in terms  of January? Yeah, if the right players are there,  
I guess we can bring players in. But again,  it's about making sure it's something that's  
going to sort of help us continuing to build  what we're doing. OK, thank you. Thank you.
title: Ange Postecoglou post-match press conference | Tottenham 3-6 Liverpool
